post.description: Creates an organization invite in PostHog.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

firstName.description: First name of the invited user.

level.description: Organization membership level (1 member, 8 administrator, 15 owner).

private_project_access[].description: List of private project access entries (team/project IDs with access levels).

sendEmail.description: Whether to send the invite email.

combinePendingInvites.description: Whether to combine with existing pending invites for the same email.

privateProjectAccess.description: Private project access mapping attached to invite.
